name: ACME BRE
summary: Improves understanding of materials flammability (extinction behaviour, conditions for sustained combustion) and tests how relevant existing flammability test methods are in low and partial gravity.
insight: A repeatable stand-in for testing cabin-material flammability, and a check on whether ground test methods hold in low gravity.
earth: ACME research targets better fuel efficiency and lower pollutant production.

name: ACME CLD Flame
summary: Extends the range of flame conditions that can be predicted by developing and verifying chemical-kinetic and soot-formation submodels.
insight: Soot and smoke production data feed smoke-detector design and combustion models.
earth: Cleaner, more efficient combustion on Earth.

name: ACME E-Field Flames
summary: Examines flame ion production and how ions can be used to control non-premixed flames.
insight: Shows how ions might be used to control flames, a possible route to new controls.
earth: Electric-field flame control for cleaner combustion.

name: ACME S-Flames
summary: Advances prediction of the structure and dynamics, including extinction, of soot-free and sooty flames.
insight: Clean spherical-flame data suit the validation of predictive flame models.
earth: Improved combustion models for engines and burners.

name: BASS
summary: One of the first investigations of how to extinguish burning fuels in microgravity.
insight: Extinguishing fires in space must account for flame geometry, which informs extinguisher design.
earth: Evidence for fire suppression and material selection.

name: BASS-II
summary: Examines whether materials burn as well in microgravity as in normal gravity, given the right conditions.
insight: Ground flammability ratings may not carry over to spacecraft, so cabin materials need space-relevant testing.
earth: Better flame-spread data for material flammability standards.

name: CFI
summary: Cool Flames Investigation: low-temperature burning that can persist when ordinary flames are hard to see.
insight: Fires that are hard to see may defeat visual checks, which strengthens the case for chemical sensing.
earth: Cool-flame chemistry matters for advanced engine design.

name: DAFT / DAFT-2
summary: Feasibility tests for measuring dust and aerosol particles in microgravity.
insight: Shows whether airborne-particle sensing works in space, which underpins smoke detection.
earth: Particle sensing for terrestrial smoke detection and air quality.

name: FLEX
summary: Flame Extinguishment Experiment: burns fuel droplets and tests how flames go out.
insight: Extinguishment limits under changing oxygen and diluent conditions inform suppressant design.

name: FLEX-2
summary: Follow-on to FLEX that extends the extinguishment studies.
insight: More extinguishment data to tune and validate suppression models.

name: Cool Flame Transitions
summary: Ground-based counterflow flame studies of cool-flame transitions at radiation and stretch extinction.
insight: Supplies model-validation data for cool-flame behaviour near extinction.

name: SAFFIRE-I
summary: Large-scale fire experiment aboard an uncrewed cargo spacecraft.
insight: The closest available data to a real spacecraft fire, essential for validating fire-growth models.
earth: Spacecraft material-flammability evidence that may inform terrestrial fire-safety testing.

name: SAFFIRE-II
summary: Further large-scale test in the SAFFIRE series of spacecraft fire experiments.
insight: Adds spacecraft-scale fire-growth data to constrain predictive models.
earth: Spacecraft material-flammability evidence that may inform terrestrial fire-safety testing.

name: SAFFIRE-III
summary: Further large-scale test in the SAFFIRE series of spacecraft fire experiments.
insight: Adds spacecraft-scale fire-growth data to constrain predictive models.
earth: Spacecraft material-flammability evidence that may inform terrestrial fire-safety testing.

name: SAME
summary: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment, focused on measuring smoke aerosols.
insight: Smoke-aerosol data are the basis for smoke-detector design.
